create_CLIC2020Image_train: create a CLIC2020Image dataset instance using the train split with a specified root directory
create_CLIC2020Image_val: create a CLIC2020Image dataset instance using the val split for validation purposes
create_CLIC2020Image_test: create a CLIC2020Image dataset instance using the test split for evaluation
download_CLIC2020Image: download and extract the CLIC2020 dataset images from the internet into the root directory
getitem_CLIC2020Image: retrieve a PIL image from the CLIC2020Image dataset by index with optional transform applied
